paragraph_01: When you use our PDF Tools service, we collect minimal information necessary to provide our services. This includes the files you upload for processing, which are temporarily stored on our servers. We may also collect basic usage data such as browser type and general location to improve our service quality and performance.
paragraph_02: The files you upload are used solely for the purpose of providing the requested PDF processing service. We do not read, analyze, or use the content of your documents for any other purpose. Usage data is collected anonymously and used to improve website performance, fix issues, and enhance user experience.
paragraph_03: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your files during upload, processing, and storage. All uploaded files are automatically and permanently deleted from our servers after one hour. We use encrypted connections (HTTPS) to ensure safe data transfer between your browser and our servers.
paragraph_04: Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience and for analytics purposes. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. We may use third-party analytics tools to understand how visitors interact with our website, helping us make improvements.
section_list_item_01: You have the right to know what data we collect about you.
section_list_item_02: You can request the deletion of any personal data we may hold.
section_list_item_03: You may contact us with any privacy-related questions or concerns.
